notes.title: April, 2022 Update!
notes.notes:
Today, we have updated the game with following details.

・Update detail
Implemented a link that forwards you to the leaderboard page from the game launcher.
Added Simplified Chinese version of the post-ending bonus novel.
Fixed some minor bugs.

・About the link goes to the leaderboard page
Added a link that forwards you to the community's leaderboard page on the game launcher.
From this update, the leaderboard is now officially available.
There is no reset for the leaderboard by this update.

・About Simplified Chinese version of the post-ending bonus novel
We apologise for the delay of implementing this.
Now you can download Simplified Chinese version of the novel from the game launcher after beating game same as English or Japanese version.

We appreciate all the support and we are looking forward to see you guys again in the next update!

notes.title: February 8, 2022 Update!
notes.notes:
Today, we have updated the game with following details.

・Update detail
Implemented the test version of the leaderboard feature
Changed the CUSTOM setting of key config

・About the test version of the leaderboard feature
This is the feature to recreate the leaderboard which existed back in Xbox360/PS3.
From the second run of the game, the score will be shown after clearing the level in every chapter.
That score will be displayed on the leaderboard of the Steam community and the players are able to compete each other with their scores.

This time, we have implemented the test version so our team can experiment and investigate to release the official version.
Caution: this is the test version hence the score might not be able to show up with the correct numbers or the test leaderboard may reset without notice. Please note this as a caution.


・About the change of the key config setting
The current key configuration can change the keys which are only used in the battle in game. However, we got the request to make the key config setting to be able to change every key.
Therefore, in this update we made the setting to be able to change the key for all game pad buttons.
Also at the same time, if you play with the keyboard, pressing ”Option” - “Control” -“Custom” can turn on the feature to swap the buttons.

Due to addition of these updates above, we recommend to do the following set up for those who were already using the custom key config setting.
1. Set up the keys that you were using previously before this update to the buttons.
2. Inside of the game, set up in each ”Option” - “Control” -“Custom”.
Sorry for the inconvenience but please try these set up.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40412747/5cff6cc449f7e70266774d98e9b4423bd49bb15a.png

We appreciate all the support and we are looking forward to see you guys again in the next update!

notes.title: December 22, 2021 Update!
notes.notes:
December 22, 2021 Update information

Today, we have made the following changes on the game as the game update.

Change list

Simplified Chinese subtitles support
Keyboard support


Regarding Simplified Chinese subtitles support
To all of El Shaddai fans from China, we are finally here!
We added Simplified Chinese subtitles on the game.
As same as other language, you can set the subtitles from option menu inside of the game.

Regarding the keyboard support
You asked and now you shall receive, the keyboard input is now supported for the game!
Keyboard configuration can only be changed on the game launcher screen.
The default setting can be checked from the manual.


Cheers.

notes.title: October 28, 2021 Update!
notes.notes:
October 28, 2021 Update information
Today, the game is updated with the following details.

・Improved the game stability
 Fixed the bug where it was crashing the game which this bug was mentioned since the initial launch of the game.

・Steam Cloud is now supported
 There were many demands since the launch of the game, now we support Steam Cloud.

・Game title change
 The game was HD supported since the release but due to bug fix and supporting the lower spec of the computer, we did not name it as HD version before. 
In this update, we have fixed one of the critical game crash hence we decided to change the name to “El Shaddai ASCENSION OF THE METATRON HD Remaster” and renewed the title logo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40412747/cfda2a8d57a8c55244a8ba2763d23cfff2fb1ab3.png

*There will be no change for the content of the game.

・About the next upcoming update
 ◇Keyboard input support
  Sorry for keeping you wait for long.
 We are currently working hard to implement this feature, please wait for a little longer.

Thank you.

notes.title: The next update schedule
notes.notes:
Dear our El Shaddai fans!

We will introduce you guys what’s coming on the next update!
・Keyboard support
・Steam cloud support
・New dialog added to guide towards the post completion bonus novel
・Bug fix/ Stabilizing the performance of the game
・Added new logo for HDremaster along with the bug fix

We are looking forward to implement them in about early November!

More information and the progress of the El Shaddai game will be tweeted from Sawaki Takeyasu’s twitter account, so please take a look!

Cheers!

notes.title: September 9th,2021 Update!
notes.notes:
September 9th,2021 Update Details

Thank you so much for playing El Shaddai.
Based on the feedback from everyone, we did the following updates.

Bug fix
・Made ScreenSetting easier.

・Fixed typographical errors.

Regarding ScreenSetting

・When Advanced Setting is changed, it caused the disappearance of some effect such as the attack effect.
We have temporary locked the feature for the DEV to investigate the bug and to prevent the new player to play the game without noticing the bug.
(This feature was not in the original game, this was our mistake that we added the advanced setting. We are sorry...)

・We have implemented Default button in ScreenSetting. 
You can initialize the setting if you press this button.
We recommend to press this button for those who changed the Advanced Setting.


Cheers!
